source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"This particular monitoring being needed only a single time, before the client's very first chemotherapy treatment cycle even begins","B":"Chemotherapy can significantly suppress bone marrow function, and CBC monitoring helps guide dose adjustments and timing of subsequent treatment cycles","C":"Chemotherapy carrying fairly weak established effect on the client's blood cell counts throughout the full course of their treatment","D":"CBC monitoring carrying fairly weak established relationship to how safely chemotherapy can actually continue to be administered"}}
source_row.rationale: Chemotherapy can significantly suppress bone marrow function, affecting white blood cells, red blood cells, and platelets, so CBC monitoring before each treatment cycle helps guide dose adjustments and appropriate timing of subsequent cycles based on the client's current blood counts and recovery.
source_row.source_name: ONS — CBC Monitoring in Chemotherapy Administration
